notes: Ladders run easiest to hardest. Every exercise is quiet: no jumping, no slams, dumbbells set down on the mat. 'equipment' lists what's required; 'a|b' means either one works. secPerRep is only used to estimate session length.

rungs.name: Incline push-up
rungs.cue: Hands on the chair seat, body in one straight line, chest to the edge.

rungs.name: Push-up
rungs.cue: Body in one straight line, elbows about 45°, chest to a fist's height off the floor.

rungs.name: Tempo push-up (3s down)
rungs.cue: Count three seconds on the way down, then press up smoothly.

rungs.name: DB floor press 20s + push-ups
rungs.cue: Floor press the 20s, set them down softly on the mat, then go right into push-ups.

rungs.name: Decline push-up
rungs.cue: Feet on the chair, squeeze glutes so the hips don't sag.

rungs.name: TRX push-up
rungs.cue: Feet in the cradles, brace hard, lower slow and keep the straps still.

rungs.name: Archer push-up
rungs.cue: Wide hands, shift onto one arm while the other stays nearly straight.

rungs.name: Band chest fly
rungs.cue: Band across your upper back, soft elbows, hug a big tree in front of you.

rungs.name: DB floor fly, 10s
rungs.cue: Lying on the mat, soft elbows, let upper arms touch the floor lightly, squeeze up.

rungs.name: DB floor fly, 20s
rungs.cue: Same arc as the 10s, slower on the way down, never let the bells drop.

rungs.name: TRX fly (high angle)
rungs.cue: Lean in only as far as you can control, arms open wide, pull back together.

rungs.name: TRX row (upright)
rungs.cue: Body stiff as a plank, pull your chest to your hands, squeeze shoulder blades.

rungs.name: TRX row (steeper)
rungs.cue: Walk feet forward for more angle, elbows close, no shrugging.

rungs.name: DB bent-over row, 20s
rungs.cue: Hinge to about 45°, flat back, row elbows toward your hips.

rungs.name: TRX row (feet elevated)
rungs.cue: Heels on the chair, hips up, pull until hands reach your ribs.

rungs.name: Single-arm TRX row
rungs.cue: Square hips to the anchor, don't let your body twist open.

rungs.name: Box squat (bodyweight)
rungs.cue: Sit back until you lightly touch the chair, stand without rocking.

rungs.name: Goblet box squat
rungs.cue: 10 or 20 lb bell at your chest, knees over toes, touch the chair, drive up.

rungs.name: Goblet squat, 20 lb
rungs.cue: Elbows inside knees at the bottom, chest tall, only as deep as knees feel good.

rungs.name: Tempo goblet squat
rungs.cue: Three seconds down, one-second pause, stand up smoothly.

rungs.name: TRX-assisted split squat
rungs.cue: Hold the handles for balance, front shin vertical, back knee toward floor.

rungs.name: Split squat, 2×10 lb
rungs.cue: Tall torso, drop straight down, front heel stays planted.

rungs.name: Rear-foot elevated split squat
rungs.cue: Back foot laces-down on the chair, lower slowly, front knee stays over the foot.

rungs.name: Glute bridge
rungs.cue: Press through heels, ribs down, squeeze glutes hard at the top.

rungs.name: DB Romanian deadlift, 2×10 lb
rungs.cue: Push hips back, bells slide down your thighs, flat back, stand tall.

rungs.name: DB Romanian deadlift, 2×20 lb
rungs.cue: Same hinge, slower down, feel the hamstrings stretch, never round.

rungs.name: Single-leg glute bridge
rungs.cue: Other knee hugged in or leg straight, keep hips level as you lift.

rungs.name: Single-leg RDL
rungs.cue: Reach the back leg long, hips square, fingertips on a wall if you wobble.

rungs.name: Band terminal knee extension
rungs.cue: Band behind the knee anchored low, straighten the leg fully and squeeze the quad.

rungs.name: Wall sit
rungs.cue: Back flat on the wall, knees over ankles, only as low as feels good.

rungs.name: Spanish squat (band)
rungs.cue: Band behind both knees anchored to something heavy, sit back, shins stay vertical.

rungs.name: Step-up (low)
rungs.cue: Use a low step, whole foot on it, push through the heel, step down softly.

rungs.name: Step-up (higher)
rungs.cue: Higher step, lean slightly forward, don't push off the back foot.

rungs.name: Dead bug
rungs.cue: Low back pressed into the floor, reach opposite arm and leg slowly.

rungs.name: Plank
rungs.cue: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze glutes, breathe behind the brace.

rungs.name: Side plank
rungs.cue: Elbow under shoulder, hips high, body in one line from head to heels.

rungs.name: Med ball Russian twist
rungs.cue: Hold the ball close, rotate from the ribs, never tap or drop it on the floor.

rungs.name: TRX body saw
rungs.cue: Feet in the cradles, forearm plank, rock slowly forward and back.

rungs.name: TRX pike
rungs.cue: Feet in the cradles, lift hips toward the ceiling, lower with control.

rungs.name: Squat to press, 10 lb
rungs.cue: Squat, stand, and press overhead in one smooth move. No jumping.

rungs.name: Slow mountain climber
rungs.cue: Step each knee in slowly, feet land silently, hips stay level.

rungs.name: Reverse lunge to press
rungs.cue: Step back softly, stand, press. Alternate legs.

rungs.name: Squat-to-press + reverse lunge
rungs.cue: One squat-to-press, one lunge each side, repeat. Steady, quiet feet.

rungs.name: Band external/internal rotation
rungs.cue: Elbow pinned to your side at 90°, rotate out then in, slow and smooth.

rungs.name: J-band reverse fly
rungs.cue: Arms straight out front, open wide, squeeze shoulder blades together.

rungs.name: Prone Y-T-W, 5 lb
rungs.cue: Face down, thumbs up, lift into Y, then T, then W. Lower the bells quietly.

rungs.name: Scap push-up
rungs.cue: Arms locked, let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push away.

rungs.name: Sleeper stretch
rungs.cue: Lie on your throwing side, gently press the forearm down. Mild stretch only.

warmup.name: Arm circles
warmup.cue: Small to big circles, forward then back. Easy pace.

warmup.name: Band pull-aparts
warmup.cue: Arms straight at shoulder height, pull the band to your chest.

warmup.name: Bodyweight squats to a box
warmup.cue: Easy tempo, tap the chair, wake the knees up gently.

warmup.name: Inchworms
warmup.cue: Walk hands out to a plank, walk them back, stand up slowly.

stretch.name: Chest doorway stretch
stretch.cue: Forearms on the door frame, step through gently until the chest opens.

stretch.name: Hip flexor stretch
stretch.cue: Half-kneeling, tuck the tailbone, shift forward a little.

stretch.name: Hamstring stretch
stretch.cue: Heel forward, leg straight, hinge at the hips with a flat back.

stretch.name: Sleeper stretch
stretch.cue: Lie on your side, gently press the forearm down. Mild stretch only.

stretch.name: Child's pose
stretch.cue: Knees wide, reach long, breathe into your back.
